title: EPUB Annotation Bridge
summary: Move EPUB highlights and notes between Calibre, KOReader, and Kobo through a local ledger.
user: Readers who sideload legal EPUBs and need highlights and notes to survive moving between Calibre-managed libraries and e-readers.
smallest_useful_product: Desktop app that watches a Calibre library plus mounted reader, imports supported highlight stores into a book-CFI ledger, exports Markdown and JSON, and writes only safe sidecar files.
constraints: No DRM circumvention; support only documented or exportable reader data; preserve original files; handle copyrighted books entirely on device.
